dossier.claim: The clearest changes affect Ayako’s competitive relationships and self-assessment. A reversed assurance makes her and Rin sore losers; other passages change her disciplinary responsibility, her decision to move past a comparison, and the person targeted by her teasing.
dossier.sourcePattern: Ayako expects both competitors to accept the wager’s outcome. Rin notices when Ayako’s genuine feelings bring out a masculine manner. As captain, Ayako speaks of disciplining unruly members and decides not to dwell on a departed superior shooter. Her school-gate remark concerns Rin, prompting Shirou’s speculation about their relationship.
dossier.englishEffect: The English calls both women sore losers and turns the observation about Ayako’s changing manner into Rin’s declaration of honesty. Controlling unruly members becomes assigning grunt work; moving past the departed member becomes discounting the teacher’s praise. At the school gate, the target changes from Rin to a man, breaking the connection to Shirou’s response.
dossier.limits: These local changes do not establish that Ayako is uniformly weaker, colder, or less capable. Sakura still attributes the breakfast complaint to her, Shirou credits her club work against Shinji’s boast, and her interpretation of his departure remains explicitly her own. The injury conversation retains her formidable reputation without presenting an expected knockout as an actual event. Her romantic preferences and the cause of Shirou’s failure to laugh remain unproved.
dossier.diagnostic: 22 findings in this category; 6 cited passages.
